saliency_check.method: Deletion test on the dual-stream member

summary: The detector rates this image likely AI-generated (score >99.9%). 2 of 3 ensemble members lean AI. This is a likelihood assessment, not proof; the cues below list the measured signals behind it.
localization_quality: SmoothGrad pixel sensitivity of the dual-stream member, the member that drives the stacked decision, computed at its native input resolution. Shows which pixels the score is most sensitive to; the deletion check cue tests whether they matter. Not a verified localization of generation artifacts.

cues.detail: dima806/deepfake_vs_real_image_detection (ViT-Base/16 (in21k), fine-tuned) scores P(AI) 7.2%. Its share of the stacked log-odds is +0.40 (toward AI).
Organika/sdxl-detector (Swin, fine-tuned on Wikimedia vs SDXL pairs) scores P(AI) 98.0%. Its share of the stacked log-odds is +0.31 (toward AI).
SignalScope PyTorch Dual-Stream Backbone (ResNet34 + 2D Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)) scores P(AI) 99.9%. Its share of the stacked log-odds is +6.15 (toward AI).

Replacing the 10% most salient pixels changes the dual-stream log-odds by -2.56; the same number of random pixels changes it by -1.09 (mean of 5 draws). Here salient pixels move the score more than random ones, so the map tracks pixels the model uses.
Share of spectral power above half-Nyquist on a native-resolution crop. Reported for inspection only; it is not calibrated as a detector and does not drive the verdict.
